哎呀，那要不要把身份拍一下，让八号玩家验的更方便一些呢？我是平民啊，嗯我觉得仓哎呀，我也分析不出来，这阵反都能说，但我觉得仓姐一个就是很单纯，总把心事写在脸上的小女孩儿即将夺冠了，应该会开心一点的吧。她真的很对对对，很不开心呢，为什么不听停听听？哎，但我又反面想他要是狼，他其实这把也也有机会能赢，他应该装出那个开心。哎，正凡都能说，但我视角里主要我警上听的，我觉得十一十二还都蛮像好人的。我觉得鹏鹏这把格格不入，警上大家都在这看热闹的。鹏鹏在那找二号玩家是倒钩了，倒不倒钩了，跟你有什么关系啊？这是牛肉干该做的事儿。是我们做的事儿吗？二号玩家发发言，鹏鹏说，我觉得你这话很像倒钩了，他有什么关系？他开始找第四个狼了，我觉得验二挺好的，要验到。二是金水的话，我就把视角进到一。嗯，对，这真的我就也不是说发言问题，就是那种不是这轮该发的眼，你知道吧？我我这轮锦上庭花，我也不知道倒钩了，我就说你儿敢找，我觉得能站我们好人能站对边就已经很不容易了，已经用尽全身的力气了啊，警上就找到通灵师了，嗯，然后就没了吧。因为奥柯的翻译一直没有听过嘛，听一听九跟十的那个对话，我倒是觉得真的像不见面。我感觉他那个陈明俊是带着一点恨意的，就是说你小子拿上好人了，就是这种感觉。陈明俊我也不知道，我就是人性分析都不准。如果就分析最后分析对了的话，那说明我年纪又大了，阅历又增长正常。年轻的小女孩应该不能盘出这么多的，肯定是我又长了一岁，嗯，世面又见多了，然后就没了啊。

      "kind": "asr_segment",

      ],
      "text": "三是茶山井果给五都行，"

      "kind": "player_instruction_context",

      "target_player_number": 10
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0005_s0410"
      ],
      "text": "因为占用年龄五就一定是好人嘛，"

      "kind": "player_instruction_context",

    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0005_s0411"
      ],
      "text": "对不对？"
    },
    {
      "candidate_status": "unknown",
      "instruction_speaker_cluster_id": "chunk_0002:speaker_3",
      "kind": "player_instruction_context",
      "matched_text": "十号玩家请发言，",

    },

      "source_segment_ids": [

      ],
      "text": "所以我是觉得我是不会去帮你改警徽流的。"

      "kind": "player_instruction_context",

      "target_player_number": 10
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0005_s0413"
      ],
      "text": "只是说现在你们确定有三张狼人牌是二号、七号、九号外置位，"

      "kind": "player_instruction_context",
      "matched_text": "十号玩家请发言，",

      "speaker_cluster_relation": "unknown_chunk_boundary",
      "speech_speaker_cluster_id": "chunk_0005:speaker_5",
      "target_player_number": 10
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0005_s0414"
      ],
      "text": "你随便验念出来的是好人。"

      "kind": "player_instruction_context",
      "matched_text": "十号玩家请发言，",

      "target_player_number": 10
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0005_s0415"
      ],
      "text": "就我觉得你可以随便验，"
    },

      "kind": "player_instruction_context",

    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0005_s0416"
      ],
      "text": "这是我的心用立场。"

      "kind": "player_instruction_context",
      "matched_text": "十号玩家请发言，",

      "target_player_number": 10
    },

      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0005_s0417"
      ],
      "text": "然后我第一天守的就是你你能守人信息呢，"

      "kind": "player_instruction_context",

    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0005_s0418"
      ],
      "text": "你今天守谁了？"
    },

      "kind": "player_instruction_context",

      ],

      "kind": "player_instruction_context",

      ],
      "text": "我第一天守在这儿，"

      ],

      ],

      "text": "八号玩家打支撑票的，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0002"
      ],
      "text": "我觉得视角也不会建近四号，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0003"
      ],
      "text": "所以轮次上就是三验了。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0004"
      ],
      "text": "三十金水是五号十号PK,"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0005"
      ],
      "text": "反正轮次也够呗，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0006"
      ],
      "text": "因为场上只有一个最后一个红狼了嘛，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0007"
      ],
      "text": "守卫还在场，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0008"
      ],
      "text": "女巫还在场。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0009"
      ],
      "text": "呃，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0010"
      ],
      "text": "三神四鸣都在场的情况下，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0011"
      ],
      "text": "我觉得是可以裸挑的嘛，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0012"
      ],
      "text": "对吧？"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0013"
      ],
      "text": "我是平民，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0014"
      ],
      "text": "然后听一下那个女巫的位置呗。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0015"
      ],
      "text": "哦，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0016"
      ],
      "text": "那确实是提前恭喜这个仓姐夺冠了，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0017"
      ],
      "text": "哎，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0018"
      ],
      "text": "让我想一下上把如果牛肉干赢了，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0019"
      ],
      "text": "仓姐输了，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0020"
      ],
      "text": "这把牛肉干赢了，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0021"
      ],
      "text": "那就是牛肉干夺冠，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0022"
      ],
      "text": "确实很亏欠。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0023"
      ],
      "text": "牛肉干怎么说呢？"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0024"
      ],
      "text": "不知道你知道吗？"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0025"
      ],
      "text": "夜里就一直在想这个事情，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0026"
      ],
      "text": "夜里一直在想，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0027"
      ],
      "text": "你知道吧？"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0028"
      ],
      "text": "因为平民夜很长嘛，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0029"
      ],
      "text": "就是你会开始想很多东西，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0030"
      ],
      "text": "然后当当时夜里的时候，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0031"
      ],
      "text": "就在想你也不知道。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0032"
      ],
      "text": "就当时我夜里女巫业我也知道就是不管，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0033"
      ],
      "text": "但是第二天我想读九号或者第三天，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0034"
      ],
      "text": "我觉得就是我就想开这个毒，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0035"
      ],
      "text": "你也不知道你每天的想法都不一样，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0036"
      ],
      "text": "我就是每天想法都不一样。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0037"
      ],
      "text": "然后我当时知道我不开毒是稳赢的，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0038"
      ],
      "text": "但是我就是很想开毒，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0039"
      ],
      "text": "我不知道为什么是命，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0040"
      ],
      "text": "好吧，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0041"
      ],
      "text": "是命，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0042"
      ],
      "text": "冲着我来别的没了。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0043"
      ],
      "text": "那个我应该是这个在五号十号里头啊，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0044"
      ],
      "text": "我听汤姐归票，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0045"
      ],
      "text": "我是一个好人，"
    }
  ],

      "text": "一是好人，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0099"
      ],
      "text": "我就默认二是狼，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0100"
      ],
      "text": "而不是二。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0101"
      ],
      "text": "为什么发现差是一个狼？"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0102"
      ],
      "text": "懂吧？"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0103"
      ],
      "text": "十一号晚上那个东西，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0104"
      ],
      "text": "其实我这样说谁是好人，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0105"
      ],
      "text": "但是我现在也不太不太敢来，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0106"
      ],
      "text": "但我告诉你，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0107"
      ],
      "text": "我是一个好人，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0108"
      ],
      "text": "我是一个平民，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0109"
      ],
      "text": "反正后面都有身份的嘛，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0110"
      ],
      "text": "你们俩不掉身份，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0111"
      ],
      "text": "那就默认平民嘛，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0112"
      ],
      "text": "对吧？"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0113"
      ],
      "text": "五、说自己平民，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0114"
      ],
      "text": "你是一个平民，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0115"
      ],
      "text": "一是所谓的四号就是女巫嘛，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0116"
      ],
      "text": "对不对？"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0117"
      ],
      "text": "后面三号、四号六号，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0118"
      ],
      "text": "我不相信他们投不出去一个狼，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0119"
      ],
      "text": "好不好？"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0120"
      ],
      "text": "我不相信你们两天吐不出这个狼这总行了吧。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0121"
      ],
      "text": "因为我确实是一个好人，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0122"
      ],
      "text": "我是平民牌啊，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0123"
      ],
      "text": "也是嗯亏钱了，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0124"
      ],
      "text": "肉干上一把，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0125"
      ],
      "text": "如果帮你投了，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0126"
      ],
      "text": "如果投了九号，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0127"
      ],
      "text": "你现在是六分，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0128"
      ],
      "text": "三号楼置警徽三后也不会故意输，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0129"
      ],
      "text": "所以他应该是冠军了的，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0130"
      ],
      "text": "是怪我了的。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0131"
      ],
      "text": "你是中途让他有可能赢，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0132"
      ],
      "text": "而我是导致他赢的那个，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0133"
      ],
      "text": "懂吗？"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0134"
      ],
      "text": "那我是平民法，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0135"
      ],
      "text": "呃，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0136"
      ],
      "text": "跟着三四六头啊，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0137"
      ],
      "text": "过了一号呢请发人，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0007_s0138"
      ],
      "text": "嗯，"
    }
  ],

我肯定无脑挂在三号身上了。现在我找了三个狼王，藏剑跟我没关系了，我还守了个平安夜，加油，我一定守住你我待会就自己去试，我就守住你，让你来决定你的因果，我觉得就是这样是最好的。然后十哎呀，真不知道谁是狼，真不知道谁是狼。我觉得十十一十二里面，其实十一还可以吧。我主要觉得十号这一轮说十二肯定是查杀。我发言发了那么久的言，我说要如果你想外置人随便验，对吧？你想外置人随便验都可以。因为已知我挑出来的目的，就是我告诉他我会守住他，我会守住他他只他第二晚他可以就是他不确定一案里面的狼是谁，在医二里面选的验一个。那么第二晚他可以随便验，所以他肯定可可以改警徽流去转验三号的呀，

所以我你说这个说十二查杀，当时听十号，这一点是聊的有点奇怪的。而且你底牌身份交一下呢，现在轮次大大领先，你肯定可以交身份啊，不会起来，就说十二是查生。那万一十二号今天出局了，游戏没有结束怎么办？你第二天是否还要表水？所以前队听十的发言确实不是很好。然后十二号的话，我警上是觉得，因为当时觉得有点像狼，是以现现在乙账号是自爆的。狼是，然后当时是跟着我去打二号的嘛，所以觉得实时啊里面可能是要好一点，然后跟着汤姐走吧，相信你你说投谁，我要投谁，我关了三号和情泡液，

结束 01:09:33.595

我觉得这个说宝玉妹妹刷嘉年华这个事没毛病。因为我答应过牛肉干，如果他得冠军，我是要给他刷一个嘉年华的，所以他现在就是莫名少挣了一个嘉年华以及一座关键。那没有啊，我我我表水我是好人的原因是因为如果我是狼，我不会在ER里面找错那个狼，因为这种局面肯定是最后一个狼要在最后一天打倒钩的，而这把预言家是一定能验到至少一天的人的，甚至守卫去守台，他会验到两天的人。那最后那个狼就一定会去打自己的同伴。就比如说呃七九是确定了两张狼，二号玩家已经在警徽流里了。那我当天一定不会说觉得一像那个狼的，因为我是我拿狼是极其心狠手辣。既然我决定战术，我就不可能在那个位置说一二，就是去榜二打一，只能是我是一个水平不高的平民啊，就就这种局势只有高配好人和狼人才能找到一二里的那个狼。就比如说三号玩家这样的高配好人和一些外缀的狼人我就是属于水平不行的好人。但是我拿狼我是不会在一二里找错的，因为他的警徽流已经留到二了。你看既然你就觉得我已经在表演我的状态，我已经在非常的拼命的去演我自己像一个好人。那么我在逻辑这一块也会跟上，让大家觉得我像一个好人的，我不会犯这种错误，让好人去有机会抓到我的马脚。打到我是狼人我是确实在一二里分错了。因为我觉得鹏鹏警上那个呃打二是倒钩狼有点急，但是警下我说真的警下他跳守卫的时候，我就觉得一更像守卫了。因为我就想明白为什么他在警上敢打。二是因为他自己底牌有身份，所以他就是觉得二不对，他就打二，包括三号玩家你就是你昨天警下发言。仓间我都觉得你很像好人了。嗯，就你说的那些点我都非常之信任。牛肉干改不改警徽流这个事儿，我觉得他不会改，因为他不验十二验你也没啥意义啊。他验了你是好人，他再去外置位找那个狼，因为你也没有很确定我是狼。比如说你昨天发言，你说你确定我是狼，他在我俩验一个也还行，对吧？你也没确定我是狼他验，你让你去找最后那那个狼，主要是他改警徽流这个事十二是好人，我觉得还是有一点那个。

这是我们的京城大师赛第二十二季、曙光航季最终的颁奖典礼的现场。在颁奖之前，首先感谢一下我们今天全场的鲜花。首先，镜头给到一号玩家，一号家鹏鹏收到了爱鹏会那粉色的那一束。一号呢鹏鹏收到了爱捧奥运会投来的鲜花留言说，京师两年，时光荏苒，初入青涩，有喜有欢，携手共进，起航，扬帆盈盈，附暖，事事舒然。我们会在每一个有意义的时刻，哪怕远隔山海，也终将相遇相守。曙光航迹不是终点。抬起头，让我们在更热烈的风里砥砺前行吧。谢谢爱鹏会运会给到我们一号家鹏鹏的鲜花，谢谢。我去追水。接下来镜头给到二号玩家baby,二号玩家baby收到了蘑菇屋会员群投来的鲜花。留言说，决赛之夜尽情博弈。输赢从不是唯一答案，偏爱你的从容心态和自带的欢乐氛围，尽享赛场乐趣。愿今夜愉快。S二十二赛季我们陪你圆满收官。谢谢蘑菇会员群给二号家波比的鲜花，谢谢。同时二号呢波比收到了克莱恩投来的大团圆留言，说感谢京城大师赛一直陪伴，祝大师在星光闪耀，祝波比享受比赛玩的开心。谢谢。克莱恩给二号玩家波比的大团圆，感谢接下来镜头给到三号玩家小仓，三号张小仓收到了雪投来的鲜花留言说玩的开心，感谢血给三号加小仓的鲜花，谢谢。好，接下来镜头给到四号玩家二珂四号玩家阿州奥科收到了科科的饲养员投来的鲜花。留言说，想这样赖着你，永永远远都不分离。没办法，你已经成为我的空气，人怎么能不呼吸？我又怎么能不爱你？缘分神秘且又神奇，别诧异，谢谢科科的饲养员给周二科的鲜花，谢谢。好，接下来镜头给到五号玩家耿雪儿、武汉家耿雪儿收到了苏鸡投来的鲜花缩机。留言说，不知不觉又一个赛季很开心。这完整的赛季可以看到雪儿宝宝萌萌c的好多名场面，不论结局为何玩的自在就好。祝雪儿顺利。五五九九，谢谢苏西给到我们五号玩家耿雪儿的鲜花，谢谢。同时，五号玩家董雪儿收到了黑仔投来的鲜花留言说，雪儿身体健康，天天开心。谢谢黑仔给到我们武汉家港雪儿的鲜花，谢谢。

      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0020"
      ],
      "text": "你做自己就好。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0021"
      ],
      "text": "双向奔赴的意义是，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0022"
      ],
      "text": "我们同因为你的故事出发，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0023"
      ],
      "text": "却走出了我们自己的故事。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0024"
      ],
      "text": "最后祝在不久的未来，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0025"
      ],
      "text": "我们守得云开见月明，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0026"
      ],
      "text": "日后光景绚烂可期。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0027"
      ],
      "text": "感谢七七九九民间小分队给七号玩家这位大师的鲜花。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0028"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢谢谢七七九九民间小分队啊。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0029"
      ],
      "text": "感谢好，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0030"
      ],
      "text": "接下来镜头给到八号玩家牛肉干八号将牛肉干收到了牛肉干干唱跳粉投来的鲜花。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0031"
      ],
      "text": "留言是一个藏头诗啊。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0032"
      ],
      "text": "留言说，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0033"
      ],
      "text": "牛刀破局，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0034"
      ],
      "text": "从容不决，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0035"
      ],
      "text": "肉眼观察谈笑，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0036"
      ],
      "text": "此在干净拆局，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0037"
      ],
      "text": "逻辑通顺干，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0038"
      ],
      "text": "拿佳绩，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0039"
      ],
      "text": "事事得利。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0040"
      ],
      "text": "藏头诗牛肉干干祝牛肉干干二十二赛季圆满落幕，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0041"
      ],
      "text": "输赢皆为经历。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0042"
      ],
      "text": "龟龟们在家等你，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0043"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢牛肝干唱跳粉，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0044"
      ],
      "text": "给到八号加牛肉干的鲜花。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0045"
      ],
      "text": "感谢谢谢谢谢。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0046"
      ],
      "text": "接下来镜头给到九号玩家金鱼对的cid没界限。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0047"
      ],
      "text": "九号男金鱼收到了全体精神病院久久的宝头来的鲜花。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0048"
      ],
      "text": "有人说，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0049"
      ],
      "text": "风雨历练，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0050"
      ],
      "text": "慢慢蜕变，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0051"
      ],
      "text": "愿你奔赴热爱，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0052"
      ],
      "text": "不负自己。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0053"
      ],
      "text": "无论结局如何，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0054"
      ],
      "text": "你已然闪闪发光，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0055"
      ],
      "text": "坚守，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0056"
      ],
      "text": "自有力量。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0057"
      ],
      "text": "十、时光不负真心愿，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0058"
      ],
      "text": "你往后一路繁花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0059"
      ],
      "text": "平安喜乐，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0060"
      ],
      "text": "继续奔赴属于你的山海。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0061"
      ],
      "text": "感谢全体精神病院。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0062"
      ],
      "text": "九九的宝给到九号玩家金鱼的鲜花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0063"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0064"
      ],
      "text": "接下来镜头给到十号玩家陈明俊，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0065"
      ],
      "text": "十号玩家陈明俊收到了非正常人类研究中心全体研究员，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0066"
      ],
      "text": "给到我们十号玩家陈明俊的鲜花。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0067"
      ],
      "text": "有人说宿主您好，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0068"
      ],
      "text": "本赛季副本即将结算，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0069"
      ],
      "text": "对局全部归档，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0070"
      ],
      "text": "君王debuff已解除新系统天天开心绑定成功系统公告。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0071"
      ],
      "text": "无论胜负，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0072"
      ],
      "text": "皆算圆满，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0073"
      ],
      "text": "胜者登顶，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0074"
      ],
      "text": "不易警性。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0075"
      ],
      "text": "此季收官，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0076"
      ],
      "text": "新城再会，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0077"
      ],
      "text": "愿好运常在，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0078"
      ],
      "text": "开心常有。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0079"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0080"
      ],
      "text": "非正常人类研究中心全体研究员给到十号玩家陈明俊的鲜花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0081"
      ],
      "text": "感谢警退。"
    }
  ],

      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0086"
      ],
      "text": "是吗？"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0087"
      ],
      "text": "好，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0088"
      ],
      "text": "十一号呢，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0089"
      ],
      "text": "宝玉妹妹收到了锦鲤小鱼护卫队投来的鲜花有言说，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0090"
      ],
      "text": "仙云弄巧，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0091"
      ],
      "text": "飞星传恨，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0092"
      ],
      "text": "银汉银悍跳条暗渡，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0093"
      ],
      "text": "月亮与玉一相逢，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0094"
      ],
      "text": "便胜却人间无数。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0095"
      ],
      "text": "祝最好的宝玉妹妹收官快乐护卫队，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0096"
      ],
      "text": "愿陪你度过朝朝暮暮。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0097"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢锦鲤小鱼护卫队投来的鲜花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0098"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0099"
      ],
      "text": "下一束一十一号，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0100"
      ],
      "text": "玩家宝玉妹妹收到了盼盼大魔王投来的鲜花留言说，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0101"
      ],
      "text": "入团锦鲤玉的第五百二十天祝，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0102"
      ],
      "text": "你所期盼的春天终会富满。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0103"
      ],
      "text": "你的山野，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0104"
      ],
      "text": "我不再赞颂你的勇气，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0105"
      ],
      "text": "我只想你天天开心。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0106"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0107"
      ],
      "text": "盼盼。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0108"
      ],
      "text": "大魔王给到十一号玩家宝玉妹妹的鲜花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0109"
      ],
      "text": "感谢说谎的羊。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0110"
      ],
      "text": "有来十一号玩家宝一妹妹收到了说谎的杨头来的鲜花留言说，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0111"
      ],
      "text": "好好睡觉，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0112"
      ],
      "text": "好好吃饭，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0113"
      ],
      "text": "玩的开心。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0114"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢说谎的，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0115"
      ],
      "text": "然后给十一号玩家宝鱼妹妹的鲜花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0116"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0117"
      ],
      "text": "十一号，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0118"
      ],
      "text": "玩家榜一妹妹收到了moricky投来的鲜花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0119"
      ],
      "text": "留言说，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0120"
      ],
      "text": "收官日快乐玩的开心。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0121"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢maricky投来的鲜花。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0122"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢OK再来一次宝贝。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0123"
      ],
      "text": "妹妹收到了mory可以投来的鲜花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0124"
      ],
      "text": "感谢mory ke的鲜花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0125"
      ],
      "text": "感谢下一个ok."
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0126"
      ],
      "text": "十一号呢？"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0127"
      ],
      "text": "宝一妹妹收到了苏鸡投来的鲜花。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0128"
      ],
      "text": "柳岩说，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0129"
      ],
      "text": "一路披荆斩棘，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0130"
      ],
      "text": "直面风雨而不坠，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0131"
      ],
      "text": "终得欣欣向荣。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0132"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢无数次。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0133"
      ],
      "text": "深夜打开手机时，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0134"
      ],
      "text": "一直都在的陪伴，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0135"
      ],
      "text": "祝宝玉老师越来越好，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0136"
      ],
      "text": "一切顺利。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0137"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢苏鸡给到我们十一号玩家，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0138"
      ],
      "text": "宝玉妹妹的鲜花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0139"
      ],
      "text": "感谢OK."
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0140"
      ],
      "text": "十一号呢，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0141"
      ],
      "text": "宝玉妹妹收到了暗淡心投来的鲜花留言说，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0142"
      ],
      "text": "千帆落尽。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0143"
      ],
      "text": "宴席中，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0144"
      ],
      "text": "兰祝宝玉妹妹此季安好静，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0145"
      ],
      "text": "后来日重逢，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0146"
      ],
      "text": "感谢安南心，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0147"
      ],
      "text": "给到十一号家宝玉妹妹的鲜花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0148"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0149"
      ],
      "text": "好，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0150"
      ],
      "text": "接下来镜头给到十二号玩家。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0151"
      ],
      "text": "李书福十二号呢，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0152"
      ],
      "text": "李书福收到了神秘人投来的鲜花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0153"
      ],
      "text": "留言说，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0154"
      ],
      "text": "祝s二十二收官快乐。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0155"
      ],
      "text": "愿你始终向阳而行，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0156"
      ],
      "text": "所有的全力以赴都有价值。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0157"
      ],
      "text": "带着这份热血，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0158"
      ],
      "text": "奔赴下一场属于你的高光。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0159"
      ],
      "text": "也祝愿大师赛越来越好，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0160"
      ],
      "text": "感谢神秘人给到我们十二行家李叔傅的鲜花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0161"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0162"
      ],
      "text": "同时，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0163"
      ],
      "text": "十二号玩家李书福收到了舒肤佳投来的鲜花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0164"
      ],
      "text": "留言说，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0165"
      ],
      "text": "希望你于生活的裂缝之中，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0166"
      ],
      "text": "倔强开花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0167"
      ],
      "text": "不惧风雨，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0168"
      ],
      "text": "磨难，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0169"
      ],
      "text": "向阳生长，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0170"
      ],
      "text": "一路收获温暖与光亮。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0171"
      ],
      "text": "相亲相爱的绿门佳人，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0172"
      ],
      "text": "感谢舒肤佳给到我们十二行家李舒芙的鲜花，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0173"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0174"
      ],
      "text": "同时，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0175"
      ],
      "text": "我们全场的所有嘉宾，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0176"
      ],
      "text": "还有解说和法官都收到了来自卡luas的鲜花。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0177"
      ],
      "text": "留言说，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0178"
      ],
      "text": "曙光航际航程落幕，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0179"
      ],
      "text": "千帆过尽，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0180"
      ],
      "text": "感谢整季带来的精彩对局，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0181"
      ],
      "text": "风浪已歇，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0182"
      ],
      "text": "好好休整，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0183"
      ],
      "text": "期待来日再度扬帆，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0184"
      ],
      "text": "奔赴新的赛场。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0185"
      ],
      "text": "期待见面会大师赛还有一万个夏天，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0186"
      ],
      "text": "感谢卢卡斯给全场的鲜花。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0187"
      ],
      "text": "感谢对对，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0188"
      ],
      "text": "另外感谢好欢螺为我们的七号玩家这位大师投食的好欢螺冲泡螺蛳粉并留言好欢螺螺蛳粉好粉，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0189"
      ],
      "text": "更有好标准，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0190"
      ],
      "text": "好欢螺。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0191"
      ],
      "text": "预祝京城大师赛粉丝见面会顺利。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0192"
      ],
      "text": "感谢好欢螺的支持，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0193"
      ],
      "text": "谢谢的你好，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0194"
      ],
      "text": "各位大宝老师们，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0195"
      ],
      "text": "您正在收看到的是京城大师赛第二十二季曙光航记的颁奖典礼。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0196"
      ],
      "text": "在我们颁场典礼开始之前呢，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0197"
      ],
      "text": "再次跟各位大宝兄们预告一下关于我们京城大赛最新的动向。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0198"
      ],
      "text": "在下一周的时候，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0199"
      ],
      "text": "我们京城大赛在每个赛季结束之后的六成联赛呢都会准时开播。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0200"
      ],
      "text": "然后呢，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0201"
      ],
      "text": "还有就是我们在八月二十九号的时候，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0202"
      ],
      "text": "苏州的这一场见面会是不容错过的。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0203"
      ],
      "text": "提醒一下各位大宝师们，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0204"
      ],
      "text": "有以下的方式，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0205"
      ],
      "text": "还是有机会可以获得我们粉丝见面会的门票。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0206"
      ],
      "text": "在微博搜索京城大师赛，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0207"
      ],
      "text": "进入超话参与活动，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0208"
      ],
      "text": "或者在优酷APP搜索京城大师赛进入到活动页面参与活动，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0209"
      ],
      "text": "或者在咪咕游戏app会员中心，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0210"
      ],
      "text": "点击立即前往参与活动。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0211"
      ],
      "text": "还有一种方式就是在酷狗app搜索京城有风参与到我们这次活动当中，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0212"
      ],
      "text": "来获取我们这一次见面会的门票。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0213"
      ],
      "text": "另外呢金石臻选现在正在开播。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0214"
      ],
      "text": "各位盗宝老师们可以点开我们的头像下方粉色链接标志进入到我们的金石甄选。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0215"
      ],
      "text": "在我们s二十二赛季的时候，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0216"
      ],
      "text": "我们推出了一系列的官方周边。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0217"
      ],
      "text": "今天是我们最后发售的时间了，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0218"
      ],
      "text": "想要收藏我们s二十二赛季的官方周面的各位大幕。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0219"
      ],
      "text": "老师们可以抓紧时间点开头，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0220"
      ],
      "text": "像下方的粉色链接标志到我们的金石，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0221"
      ],
      "text": "真的直播间来，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0222"
      ],
      "text": "抓紧时间抢购，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0223"
      ],
      "text": "最后一波错过了之后就已经成绝版了。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0224"
      ],
      "text": "然后呢，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0225"
      ],
      "text": "各位弹幕老师们，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0226"
      ],
      "text": "我们在下周二的时候也会在金石甄选来发布我们的见面会的周边。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0227"
      ],
      "text": "下周二是我们的首发上线。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0228"
      ],
      "text": "这一次我们有很多的弹幕老师可能没有办法去到苏州来参与到我们这次见面会的活动当中。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0229"
      ],
      "text": "但是我们依然期待有更多担幕老师们可以跟我们一起共享这次见面会的盛况。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0230"
      ],
      "text": "这一系列周边呢在下周二的时候都可以到我们的金狮臻选直播间来采购的。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0231"
      ],
      "text": "到接下来就进入到我们h二十二赛季的颁奖环节。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0232"
      ],
      "text": "首先我们将颁发一系列的单项奖。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0233"
      ],
      "text": "第一个为各位颁发的是我们的最佳新秀奖获奖的人选，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0010_s0234"
      ],
      "text": "请看大屏幕。"
    }
  ],

02:03:01.195未归属结束候选未归属发言未知 / 未归属声纹候选：未标记

一、先恭喜各位中奖的朋友们，非常啊不是得奖的朋友们，不中奖跟中奖了一样开心吗？尤其是恭喜桑姐拿到了冠军，真的看到苍姐很开心，感觉自己也感受到很幸福的氛围了。嗯，然后这个赛季呢落下，现在又落下了帷幕，没想到一下又在大润赛又过了一个赛季。这个赛季呢有自己认为吧，有高高的时候，也有很遗憾的时候玩很菜的时候。然后但是很庆幸，因为我的家人们一直支持我，让我保住了长达半年的后缀了，就都是大家一分一分儿打上来的。嗯，然后我们也希望未来的日子可以一起在进步，一起更好。嗯，然后我们下赛季见我谢一下。今天呢就是给大家给我的投十一个是回声哥，豆豆查杀斯，还有卢卡斯，还有今天的花花，是有很多家人们一起投的，我一起都谢一下，谢谢小一，谢谢丹尼尔，谢谢回声，谢六二七七，谢谢酿酿呀，谢谢侦探菠萝，谢谢help,谢谢DYD,谢谢豆豆，谢谢艾坤，谢谢巴尔盖，谢谢mumusic,谢谢僵尸粉，谢谢好友团，谢谢空明子，谢谢每一位家人们的支持，我们明日再见，下次再见过了，

结束 02:04:16.930

02:15:59.020未归属结束候选未归属发言未知 / 未归属声纹候选：未标记

嗯，十一点钟那个啊我们其实每一季都都过得特别快啊，时间过得特别快，我们我们已经就在在在抖音做了十多集比赛了，大家在也已经二十多g了啊，然后我们我们肯定很多人都有遗憾啊，然后但是也有也有有很多人都会也已经取到不错的成绩了啊，所以我觉得呃没关系吧，因为我们未来还有很多很多机等着大家啊，然后我们还是立志于呈现更好的赛事，给我们热爱狼人杀的观众们呈现更好内容啊，当然了呃是赛事就有胜负就有输赢。然后我是觉得我们这一季赛季的冠军争夺其实要比往季都热烈一些，就大家更注重这些东西了。呃，所以呢我觉得这是一个好事儿啊，然后我们呃下一季的主题主题叫做昆仑龟须啊，昆仑归票，然后是一个山海经的主题啊，我们每一季也是在不停的更换自己的主题，希望大家能够看的更开心啊。然后同时我们在那个二零二六年的八月二十九号的晚上六点半啊，会有我们的见面会啊，大家可以这个还有票啊，大家可以根据渠道的宣传，拿一些票然，后来参加一下我们见面会。同样我们下周就要去见面会了啊，但是我们大家赛呢也是这个在见面会之后马上就会回归到我们第二三季啊，也是希望观众朋友们届时可以收看啊，最后感谢我的粉丝们给我们呃首先我的我的粉丝给我投的花啊，包括投石啊等等，也感谢我们大家赛的粉丝们，给各位的爱播都真的是这个支持到底了。所以今天我们那个决赛结束，那也是感谢所有粉丝们对我们竞争大赛支持。那我们就下一期再见啊。

结束 02:17:46.705

      "text": "希望大家能够看的更开心啊。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0334"
      ],
      "text": "然后同时我们在那个二零二六年的八月二十九号的晚上六点半啊，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0335"
      ],
      "text": "会有我们的见面会啊，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0336"
      ],
      "text": "大家可以这个还有票啊，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0337"
      ],
      "text": "大家可以根据渠道的宣传，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0338"
      ],
      "text": "拿一些票然，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0339"
      ],
      "text": "后来参加一下我们见面会。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0340"
      ],
      "text": "同样我们下周就要去见面会了啊，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0341"
      ],
      "text": "但是我们大家赛呢也是这个在见面会之后马上就会回归到我们第二三季啊，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0342"
      ],
      "text": "也是希望观众朋友们届时可以收看啊，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0343"
      ],
      "text": "最后感谢我的粉丝们给我们呃首先我的我的粉丝给我投的花啊，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0344"
      ],
      "text": "包括投石啊等等，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0345"
      ],
      "text": "也感谢我们大家赛的粉丝们，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0346"
      ],
      "text": "给各位的爱播都真的是这个支持到底了。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0347"
      ],
      "text": "所以今天我们那个决赛结束，"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0348"
      ],
      "text": "那也是感谢所有粉丝们对我们竞争大赛支持。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "asr_segment",
      "source_segment_ids": [
        "c0013_s0349"
      ],
      "text": "那我们就下一期再见啊。"
    }
  ],

好，谢谢我们的y哥，谢谢我们全场各位嘉宾们的赛后感言，我们请各位嘉宾们到我们后边的位置来准备合影留念。各位弹幕老师们，竞城大赛第二十二赛季曙光航迹即将落下帷幕。在节目的最后，再次感谢所有弹幕老师们一个赛季。对于我们节目的大力支持，也要感谢我们长期以来的合作。那边那边那边长期以来的合作伙伴天天狼APP.对于本节目的大力支持，各位代宝朋友们记得到各大用商店来搜索并下载天天狼人来跟我们一起玩。京城大赛同款版型。八月二十九号，在苏州，我们即将召开我们这一次京城大师赛的十年，共赴今夜入局的粉丝见面会。然后我们还有最后的几种获得粉丝见面会、门票的方式。在微博搜索京城大师赛，进入超话参与活动，或者在优酷app搜索京城大师赛进入活动页面参与活动，或者在咪咕游戏app会员中心点击立即前往参与活动，或者在酷狗app搜索京城有风来参与到我们的粉丝抢票的活动当中。另外，s二十二赛季曙光航迹的官方周边正在金石甄选发售。最后一点时间了，各位大宝老师们抓紧最后的机会，如果错过了，就成绝版了。各位大宝师们，下周我们的六城联赛将在我们的京城大师赛赛事号当中上演。下一周我们经过一个周的六十年赛之后，再隔一周京城大师赛，第二十三赛季昆仑归墟，我们再见啦。感谢各位大宝石们一个赛季的陪伴，拜拜合影啦。
